Proof in the paper: The XRD pattern (Fig. 2d) showed the main peaks at 30.09°, 42.97°, 43.27 and 53.38° which were corresponded to the (22−1), (132), (42−2), and (24−1) planes of Cu6Sn5 (PDF#45–1488). TEM images in Fig. 2e showed that Cu6Sn5 were assembled by villous nanoparticles. The high-resolution TEM image (Fig. 2f) revealed that the crystal lattice spacing was estimated to be 0.304 nm, which was in accordance with the (22−1) crystal face of Cu6Sn5.
